code_build.solver_dependencies: none; finite-action minimax and fixed-plan geometry only
code_build.flags: C++ target: -O3 -DNDEBUG -std=c++20 -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Werror; no project solver or geometry dependencies outside finite-action minimax modules

protocol.order: one excluded warmup, then seven sequential calls
protocol.workspace_policy: fresh request constructed per call; no explicit retained workspace

timing.scope: request construction and finite_action_minimax public call; excludes result-summary checks, JSON serialization, process startup, exact oracle, figure and HTML rendering
timing.limiter_profile: not collected; descriptive single-adapter evidence, no speedup claim

resources.scope: cumulative process maximum across warmup and seven measured calls; not an individual-call peak
